extracted text: AA2219 is in T87 temper condition (solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour) + 7% stretched followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours). The hardness of the base metal was measured to be 128 Hv (Vickers hardness). The paper examines stress corrosion cracking behavior of the base metal, as-welded, and repair-welded specimens. AA2219 is a precipitation-hardenable alloy widely used in aerospace industries for the fabrication of cryogenic propellant tanks due to its high strength, good weldability, and stress corrosion resistance.
